cursorUp: Return the ANSI escape sequence that moves the cursor up `n` lines.
cursorDown: Return the ANSI escape sequence that moves the cursor down `n` lines.
cursorForward: Return the ANSI escape sequence that moves the cursor forward `n` columns.
cursorBack: Return the ANSI escape sequence that moves the cursor back `n` columns.
cursorNextLine: Return the ANSI escape sequence that moves the cursor to the start of the line `n` lines down.
cursorPreviousLine: Return the ANSI escape sequence that moves the cursor to the start of the line `n` lines up.
cursorPosition: Return the ANSI escape sequence that moves the cursor to `column` and, if given, `row`.
scrollUp: Return the ANSI escape sequence that scrolls the display up `n` lines.
scrollDown: Return the ANSI escape sequence that scrolls the display down `n` lines.
constants: The raw escape sequence building blocks: `ESC`, `CSI`, and the `SGR` (Select Graphic Rendition) sequence builder.
cursorHide: ANSI escape sequence that hides the cursor.
cursorShow: ANSI escape sequence that shows the cursor.
eraseDisplayEnd: ANSI escape sequence that erases the display from the cursor to the end.
eraseDisplayStart: ANSI escape sequence that erases the display from the start to the cursor.
eraseDisplay: ANSI escape sequence that erases the entire display.
eraseLineEnd: ANSI escape sequence that erases the line from the cursor to the end.
eraseLineStart: ANSI escape sequence that erases the line from the start to the cursor.
eraseLine: ANSI escape sequence that erases the entire line.
modifierReset: SGR escape sequence that resets all modifiers.
modifierBold: SGR escape sequence that enables bold text.
modifierDim: SGR escape sequence that enables dim text.
modifierItalic: SGR escape sequence that enables italic text.
modifierUnderline: SGR escape sequence that enables underlined text.
modifierNormal: SGR escape sequence that resets bold/dim to normal intensity.
modifierNotItalic: SGR escape sequence that disables italic text.
modifierNotUnderline: SGR escape sequence that disables underlined text.
colorBlack: SGR escape sequence that sets the foreground color to black.
colorRed: SGR escape sequence that sets the foreground color to red.
colorGreen: SGR escape sequence that sets the foreground color to green.
colorYellow: SGR escape sequence that sets the foreground color to yellow.
colorBlue: SGR escape sequence that sets the foreground color to blue.
colorMagenta: SGR escape sequence that sets the foreground color to magenta.
colorCyan: SGR escape sequence that sets the foreground color to cyan.
colorWhite: SGR escape sequence that sets the foreground color to white.
colorDefault: SGR escape sequence that resets the foreground color to the default.
colorBrightBlack: SGR escape sequence that sets the foreground color to bright black.
colorBrightRed: SGR escape sequence that sets the foreground color to bright red.
colorBrightGreen: SGR escape sequence that sets the foreground color to bright green.
colorBrightYellow: SGR escape sequence that sets the foreground color to bright yellow.
colorBrightBlue: SGR escape sequence that sets the foreground color to bright blue.
colorBrightMagenta: SGR escape sequence that sets the foreground color to bright magenta.
colorBrightCyan: SGR escape sequence that sets the foreground color to bright cyan.
colorBrightWhite: SGR escape sequence that sets the foreground color to bright white.
KeyDecoder: Transform stream that decodes ANSI input escape sequences from a readable stream into `Key` objects.
KeyDecoder.constructor: Create a `KeyDecoder`, optionally configuring the input `encoding` and `escapeCodeTimeout`.
KeyDecoder.encoding: The encoding used to decode incoming byte data into characters.
KeyDecoderOptions.encoding: Encoding used to decode incoming byte data into characters. Defaults to `'utf8'`.
KeyDecoderOptions.escapeCodeTimeout: Milliseconds to wait for further bytes after a lone escape character before treating it as the `escape` key. Defaults to `500`.
Key: A single decoded key press, including its name, raw sequence, and modifier state.
Key.constructor: Create a `Key` with the given `name`, raw `sequence`, and modifier flags.
Key.name: The decoded key name, for example `'up'`, `'return'`, or a single character.
Key.sequence: The raw input sequence the key was decoded from.
Key.ctrl: Whether the Ctrl modifier was held.
Key.meta: Whether the Meta (Alt) modifier was held.
Key.shift: Whether the Shift modifier was held.
